statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in main() of the thumbnail program (tools/thumbnail.c), fixed upstream by commit 9ce4d089bcf25496663776d9e6336738112f09a3 (libtiff issue 790). thumbnail is not part of the library: upstream builds it only as a test program and never installs it (tools/CMakeLists.txt at v4.7.0: 'rgb2ycbcr and thumbnail are intended to *NOT* be installed. They are for testing purposes only'; tools/Makefile.am lists it only under EXTRA_PROGRAMS and check_PROGRAMS). Debian notes that thumbnail is not included in its binary packages and has not fixed it in trixie (urgency unimportant, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-52491), so the absence was checked in what DHI ships. DHI unpacked every tiff package in the DHI Debian repository as of 2026-11-28 (one build, on amd64 and arm64: libtiff6, libtiffxx6, libtiff-dev, libtiff5-dev, libtiff-tools, libtiff-opengl and the four -dbgsym packages). libtiff-tools installs 18 programs (fax2ps, fax2tiff, pal2rgb, ppm2tiff, raw2tiff, tiff2bw, tiff2pdf, tiff2ps, tiff2rgba, tiffcmp, tiffcp, tiffcrop, tiffdither, tiffdump, tiffinfo, tiffmedian, tiffset, tiffsplit) and no thumbnail program; only the thumbnail(1) manual page ships. Apart from the upstream ChangeLog text that six of these packages ship (usr/share/doc/<package>/changelog.gz, whose history mentions thumbnail.c), no file in these packages contains the source name thumbnail.c or its functions generateThumbnail, setupStepTables and setupBitsTables: not an ELF program or library, not a member of the libtiff.a and libtiffxx.a static archives, and not a detached debug file (searched with its compressed debug sections decompressed). The same search finds the source name and functions of shipped tools (tiff2bw.c and compresscontig from tiff2bw, readSeparateTilesIntoBuffer from tiffcrop). Earlier tiff builds are no longer published and were not unpacked; they come from the same upstream build rules and the same Debian packaging, which installs only the programs upstream installs.
